}}'''Vane''' was a lacquerware merchant and a [[Darkfriend]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Vane, Master}}

== Appearance ==
He had graying hair, and was stocky with a pendulous lower lip.

== Activities ==
He was playing dice in the town of Maderin when [[Matrim Cauthon|Mat]] asked to join the game. Vane recognized Mat and left the table to gather other men. They attacked Mat and [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag|Tuon]] as they were leaving town. Vane was one of the first to fall to one of Mat's knives.
